author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
A walk near Hardy's Monument on a blustery and wet day in January; a bit of foraging and general looking at nature, then home for a bit of cooking with the foraged ingredients.

Join the Atomic Shrimp official Discord server for FREE early access to videos! - https://discord.gg/atomicshrimp
